remaining_delivery_constraints.current_support: Delivery 1.1 may pair input and handoff from different pinned repositories/commits, but every in-document source/article/retry locator is a relative path resolved in that document repository/commit. Separate snapshots of dependencies must be explicitly bundled.
unsupported: A Knowledge source locator pointing directly at another repo/commit URL
Handoff v2 kind=commit artifact whose locator is a fixed GitHub commit URL
Handoff v2 upstream dependency at a fixed URL in another commit/repository
remaining_delivery_constraints.current_result: These documents may pass their standalone schema validators, but the delivery CLI rejects their locators. They are not delivered or certified. P-A does not resolve the reported B1 delivery constraint and does not authorize B1 execution.
remaining_delivery_constraints.not_workarounds: Never delete fixed URLs, relabel commit artifacts as text, rewrite original bytes, infer equivalence to a snapshot, or skip delivery validation. A separately approved derived source snapshot can be delivered under the current local-path profile only as a new explicit representation; it does not retroactively deliver the original URL-bound document.
minimum_followup_contract: Introduce an explicitly versioned outer binding extension. Keep the immutable Handoff/Knowledge document, its original locator/revision and status/attempt unchanged. Preserve Delivery 1.0/1.1 rejection of the new representation.

Bind each owner-document fixed reference and structured slot (artifact ID, upstream identity or finding/source position) to the exact original locator and revision and to one typed target. Reject missing, extra, duplicate, ambiguous and conflicting mappings; no generic URL auto-fetch or locator-only existence proof.

For a source or upstream Handoff blob, target is canonical repository/40hex commit/path/size/sha256. Match a strictly parsed canonical fixed GitHub blob URL and original revision to the target; fetch every required dependency, run its typed validator and verify role/task_id/attempt/retry scope. Use isolated HTTPS Git, path/tree checks and bounded raw bytes. Do not accept mutable branch URLs or redirects.

For kind=commit, define a separate git-commit-object target rather than a text/blob disguise: repository, full commit OID, raw commit object size and SHA-256. Require the canonical commit URL and full revision to match, fetch that exact commit, require cat-file type commit and FETCH_HEAD equality, hash full raw commit-object bytes, and include those typed bytes in the bundle and receipts. Existence of the commit object alone does not certify its tree/files, build, changes or product behavior; list and validate any required tree/blob evidence separately.

Extend manifest/publication/consumption/authorization schemas and version dispatch together. Authorization still binds all targets through the manifest pin and exact consumer/scope/purpose/expiry; receipts grant no rights. Define how output object bytes are represented and how complete bundles avoid circular self-digest references.

Add real fixed cross-repo/commit normal and tamper tests for URL/OID/path/type/size/hash mismatch, unlisted source/upstream, missing dependency, duplicate slots, private-only, downgrade, symlink/gitlink, retry identity, authorization and legacy regression before independent Test/Review.
remaining_delivery_constraints.scope_decision: Design/report only; no P-A code expansion, B1 or app repo edit, Agent launch, or claim of resolved cross-repository URL delivery.
